goal: Add booking.money.format_cents(value) to format signed integer cents as a decimal string with exactly two fractional digits. Do not use floats or Decimal.
constraints: Import InvalidRequest from .errors and raise it for every non-exact-int value, including bool.
Only implement format_cents and its required import, under 25 lines. Preserve negative signs; zero must not have a negative sign. No currency symbol or grouping separators.
Use integer arithmetic; arbitrary-sized Python integers must retain precision.
acceptance: True, False, float, string and None raise InvalidRequest.
